label: pair_disposition
disposition_sql:
CASE
        WHEN n_legs <> 2                      THEN 'not_two_leg'
        WHEN n_open < 2                       THEN 'partial_open'
        WHEN ABS(sum_open - 1) <= 0.02       THEN 'complementary'
        WHEN min_open = max_open
             AND n_over = 1 AND n_under = 1
             AND n_win = 1                    THEN 'repairable_named_ou'
        WHEN min_open = max_open              THEN 'nonrepairable_identical'
        ELSE                                       'other_noncomp'
      END
note: disposition is a single ordered CASE, so every market has exactly one value and the arms sum to the population by construction. CERT-403A P1#2 exists because a cross-tab let two different margins be quoted about the same rows.
